mapper.insert: insert ignore into event_reminder_logs (house_id, category, record_id, event_date, notify_date, notify_time) select b.house_id, '生产', br.id, br.next_event_date, curdate(), now() from batch_rabbits br inner join batches b on b.id = br.batch_id where b.house_id = #{houseId} and br.is_active = true and br.next_event_date is not null and br.next_event_date <= #{today} and br.is_event_notified = false
